results.title: The Perpetual Journey to the Homeland
results.overview: Over 30 years of fieldwork, photographer Randa Shaath built an extensive archive of Palestine: decades of photographs of the people and places she calls home. In her living room, we open the archive together, guided by her rare gift for remembering a story behind each photo.  One more return to Albelad (the homeland), she glides through the photos, and with every return, a story surfaces. She holds onto a narrative in which hope was possible, and a free Palestine never felt far away.

results.title: Visitas de Uma Parente Afastada
results.overview: Over the course of seven years, Mariana Viegas photographed the sets of some of the last productions shot on 35mm. Today, she returns to the perspective she had as a young woman, back when she worked with directors such as Šarūnas Bartas, Pedro Costa, João César Monteiro and Manoel de Oliveira. Joined by a few guests, she will take us on a journey through a surprising archive, in an encounter between photography and cinema, creation and life.

results.title: In Between
results.overview: Trapped within a fracturing dreamscape where time and reality warp the moment they are observed, Emily (Elizabeth Davis) finds herself navigating a sinister, shifting nightmare. As the boundaries between memory and delusion dissolve, she realizes this psychological maze isn't merely a construct of her own mind, but a terrifying reality manipulated by her ex-partner, Claudia.  ​Isolated in atmospheric distortion and haunted by surreal temporal loops, Emily is forced to confront the lingering trauma and emotional control of her past relationship. In a place where trusting her senses means losing her mind, she must find a way to break free before the nightmare consumes her completely.

results.title: A Casa É a Ruína de uma Casa
results.original_title: A Casa É a Ruína de uma Casa
results.overview: The House Is the Ruin of a House maps a tiny house that has stood for a hundred years at the centre of the mouth of a giant, barely extinct volcano. It speaks of the permanence of this house, but also of its imminent disappearance. It follows the enormous, broad, contradictory, threatening, deafening movements of the earth, the wind, the sea and the weather, and projects a future of extinction onto the present (a landscape that resembles that of a distant past).

results.title: Maayam
results.overview: Some things we hold on to without knowing why. When Parthi finds something in his bag that he has no memory of owning, an ordinary afternoon in the park begins to unravel. As he searches for answers, the hours slip away from him, and he starts to suspect that he is not the only one who knows where he is going.

results.title: SILENT ANXIETY
results.overview: Neil is tired. Tired of college, tired of the constant reminders from home, and tired of pretending that everything is fine. A simple message from his mother becomes one more thing he has to carry alone.  Follow him through a single, restless day of headphones, half-hearted shrugs, and quiet moments where his composure starts to slip. Where his day takes him is something you'll have to see for yourself.  Silent Anxiety never explains what is wrong, and it doesn't have to. It's about the anxiety people carry quietly, often hidden behind indifference, and the loneliness of not having the words to say it.
